```{r}
make_delta_boxplot <- function(df,
                               keep_contrasts = c("External over blank", "Lag over blank"),
                               title = expression("Phase-specific incremental support (" * Delta * R^2 * ")")) {
  df_plot <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(contrast %in% keep_contrasts)

  no_finite_values <- nrow(df_plot) == 0L || !any(is.finite(df_plot$delta_r2))
  if (no_finite_values) {
    dataset_levels <- unique(as.character(df$dataset))
    if (length(dataset_levels) == 0L) dataset_levels <- "dataset unavailable"
    df_plot <- tidyr::expand_grid(
      dataset = dataset_levels,
      contrast = keep_contrasts,
      phase = factor(c("early", "mid", "late"), levels = c("early", "mid", "late"))
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(delta_r2 = NA_real_)
  }

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = phase, y = delta_r2)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey40")

  if (!no_finite_values) {
    p <- p +
      geom_boxplot(
        fill = "grey80",
        width = 0.58,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        alpha = 0.72,
        color = "grey25"
      ) +
      geom_jitter(
        width = 0.10,
        height = 0,
        size = 1.3,
        alpha = 0.45,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      stat_summary(
        fun = median,
        geom = "point",
        shape = 23,
        size = 2.7,
        fill = "white",
        color = "black"
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    facet_grid(contrast ~ dataset, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = expression(Delta * R^2)
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey70"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  if (no_finite_values) {
    notice <- df_plot %>%
      dplyr::distinct(dataset, contrast) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(phase = factor("mid", levels = c("early", "mid", "late")), delta_r2 = 0)
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = notice,
      aes(x = phase, y = delta_r2, label = "No finite delta-R2 values"),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "grey35",
      size = 3
    )
  }

  p
}

wilcox_early_vs_late_p <- function(y, phase, min_n = 2) {
  y_early <- y[phase == "early" & !is.na(y)]
  y_late  <- y[phase == "late"  & !is.na(y)]

  if (length(y_early) < min_n || length(y_late) < min_n) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  stats::wilcox.test(
    y_early,
    y_late,
    exact = FALSE
  )$p.value
}

format_p_label <- function(p, prefix = "FDR p") {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "n too small",
    p < 0.001 ~ paste0(prefix, " < 0.001"),
    TRUE ~ paste0(prefix, " = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
  )
}

make_early_late_stats <- function(df,
                                  facet_vars,
                                  keep_contrasts = c("External over blank", "Lag over blank"),
                                  adjust_method = "BH",
                                  label_prefix = "FDR p") {
  df_test <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      contrast %in% keep_contrasts,
      phase %in% c("early", "late"),
      !is.na(delta_r2)
    )

  test_tbl <- df_test %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(facet_vars))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_early = sum(phase == "early"),
      n_late = sum(phase == "late"),
      p_value = wilcox_early_vs_late_p(delta_r2, phase),
      y_min = min(delta_r2, na.rm = TRUE),
      y_max = max(delta_r2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = adjust_method),
      label = format_p_label(p_adj, prefix = label_prefix),
      y_range = dplyr::if_else(
        is.finite(y_max - y_min) & (y_max - y_min) > 0,
        y_max - y_min,
        0.01
      ),
      y = y_max + 0.10 * y_range,
      y_tip = y_max + 0.04 * y_range,
      y_label = y_max + 0.18 * y_range,
      x_start = "early",
      x_end = "late",
      x_label = "mid"
    )

  test_tbl
}

early_midlate_sig_layers <- function(stat_tbl,
                                     text_size = 3,
                                     line_width = 0.35) {
  list(
    geom_segment(
      data = stat_tbl,
      aes(x = x_start, xend = x_end, y = y, yend = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = line_width
    ),
    geom_segment(
      data = stat_tbl,
      aes(x = x_start, xend = x_start, y = y_tip, yend = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = line_width
    ),
    geom_segment(
      data = stat_tbl,
      aes(x = x_end, xend = x_end, y = y_tip, yend = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = line_width
    ),
    geom_text(
      data = stat_tbl,
      aes(x = x_label, y = y_label, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = text_size
    )
  )
}

```

```{r}
extract_delta_from_comparison_tbl <- function(comparison_tbl,
                                              dataset_label,
                                              external_spec_label) {
  comparison_tbl %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Sample.Name,
      ptrap,
      date,
      phase,
      delta_ext_over_blank,
      delta_lag_over_blank
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(delta_ext_over_blank, delta_lag_over_blank),
      names_to = "contrast",
      values_to = "delta_r2"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dataset = dataset_label,
      external_spec = external_spec_label,
      contrast = dplyr::recode(
        contrast,
        delta_ext_over_blank = "External over blank",
        delta_lag_over_blank = "Lag over blank"
      ),
      phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late")),
      external_spec = factor(
        external_spec,
        levels = c("prev_day", "recent_3d", "recent_3d_decay"),
        labels = c("1 d summary", "3 d summary", "3 d decay")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(dataset, external_spec, phase, contrast, delta_r2)
}

delta_25_sensitivity <- dplyr::bind_rows(

    source_comparison_tables_25$prev_day,
```

## CLR taxon-level attribution

```{r}
extract_species_label <- function(x, fallback_to_genus = TRUE) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  vapply(strsplit(x, ";", fixed = TRUE), function(parts) {
    sp <- parts[grepl("^s__", parts)]
    if (length(sp) > 0) {
      out <- sub("^s__", "", sp[1])
      if (!is.na(out) && nzchar(out)) return(out)
    }

    if (fallback_to_genus) {
      gn <- parts[grepl("^g__", parts)]
      if (length(gn) > 0) {
        out <- sub("^g__", "", gn[1])
        if (!is.na(out) && nzchar(out)) return(out)
      }
    }

    sub("^.*__", "", tail(parts, 1))
  }, character(1))
}

```

### Treated p-traps: external-input and lag attribution

```{r}
make_taxon_phase_summary_filtered <- function(feature_level_tbl,
                                              ptraps_keep = c("1", "3"),
                                              phases_keep = c("early", "late")) {
  feature_level_tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ptrap = as.character(ptrap),
      phase = as.character(phase)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      ptrap %in% ptraps_keep,
      phase %in% phases_keep
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(phase, taxon_label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(Sample.Name),
      prevalence_in_phase = mean(observed_ra > 0, na.rm = TRUE),

      sum_imp_ext_over_blank = sum(improve_ext_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_imp_ext_over_blank = mean(improve_ext_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_imp_ext_over_blank = median(improve_ext_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_pos_ext_over_blank = mean(improve_ext_over_blank > 0, na.rm = TRUE),

      sum_imp_lag_over_blank = sum(improve_lag_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_imp_lag_over_blank = mean(improve_lag_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_imp_lag_over_blank = median(improve_lag_over_blank, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_pos_lag_over_blank = mean(improve_lag_over_blank > 0, na.rm = TRUE),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      phase = factor(phase, levels = c("early", "mid", "late"))
    )
}

taxon_phase_summary_25_treated <- make_taxon_phase_summary_filtered(
  res_taxon_25_feature_level,
  ptraps_keep = c("1", "3")
)

taxon_phase_summary_35_hc_treated <- make_taxon_phase_summary_filtered(
  res_taxon_35_hc_feature_level,
  ptraps_keep = c("1", "3")
)
```


```{r}
make_taxa_bar_from_summary <- function(taxon_phase_summary,
                                       phase_keep,
                                       value_col,
                                       title,
                                       xlab,
                                       top_n = 15,
                                       min_prev = 0.10,
                                       min_n = 3) {
  value_col <- rlang::ensym(value_col)

  plot_tbl <- taxon_phase_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(phase) == phase_keep,
      prevalence_in_phase >= min_prev,
      n_samples >= min_n
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(!!value_col)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      short_label = extract_species_label(taxon_label, fallback_to_genus = TRUE),
      short_label = make.unique(short_label),
      short_label = forcats::fct_reorder(short_label, !!value_col)
    )

  ggplot(plot_tbl, aes(x = !!value_col, y = short_label)) +
    geom_col(fill = "grey40") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = xlab,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11.5) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}

taxon_panel_theme <- theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
  plot.tag.position = c(0, 1),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
  plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
)
```
